basis: FD4 playback v1 stopped before neural/game execution because FD-1 tuples did not carry a hold head shape label. A separate current-render-frame stream adds the visible tap/hold head feature.
chart: xi - FREEDOM DiVE (razlteh), FREEDOM DiVE 4K Normal
engineering_assumptions: Crop raw screen positions outside the playfield and invert FD-1 raw coordinate: progress=1-raw_position.
The fly sees a current rendered tap/hold head shape label, not map object type or a note ID.
Use current frame only; choose nearest head and fan exact-position ties to visible lanes.
Use at most four per-lane-reduced current tail positions; release a held key when its nearest visible tail reaches raw position 0.
Reset TTC when nearest-head progress moves backward by more than one rendered pixel.
After selected-head switch or cue end, provide 11 blank 1-ms samples before new sensory input.
Latch cue entry and clip TTC countdown increases within each selected cue (FD2-A8).
Pair each UP to the original DOWN lanes; at most two active holds are supported.
pass: Exact chart hash and object counts; deterministic full replay; one continuous neural initialization; unchanged weights; all 1,310 objects receive final head/tap judgement; each emitted DOWN has a matching UP; no key remains held at end. Score and miss patterns are descriptive, not optimization targets.
